name: AxonFlow Governance
description: Policy enforcement, approval gates, and audit trails for OpenClaw tool execution and outbound messages. Sends governance events to AxonFlow Community SaaS (try.getaxonflow.com) by default; set pluginConfig.endpoint for self-hosted, AXONFLOW_COMMUNITY_SAAS=0 to disable auto-registration, AXONFLOW_TELEMETRY=off to disable the 7-day anonymous heartbeat.

AXONFLOW_TELEMETRY.description: Set to 'off', '0', 'false', or 'no' to disable the 7-day anonymous telemetry heartbeat. When unset (default), the plugin sends a lightweight ping to checkpoint.getaxonflow.com once every 7 days per machine.

AXONFLOW_COMMUNITY_SAAS.description: Set to '0', 'false', 'off', or 'no' to disable auto-registration with try.getaxonflow.com Community SaaS. When opted out, configure pluginConfig.endpoint to point at a self-hosted AxonFlow instance — otherwise the plugin loads but cannot enforce policy.

AXONFLOW_CACHE_DIR.description: Override the per-user cache directory used for telemetry stamps and rate-limit backoffs. Defaults to OS conventions: $XDG_CACHE_HOME/axonflow on Linux, ~/Library/Caches/axonflow on macOS, %LOCALAPPDATA%\axonflow on Windows.

AXONFLOW_CONFIG_DIR.description: Override the per-user config directory used for the Community-SaaS registration file (mode 0o600). Defaults to OS conventions: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/axonflow on Linux, ~/Library/Application Support/axonflow on macOS, %APPDATA%\axonflow on Windows.

AXONFLOW_LICENSE_TOKEN.description: AxonFlow Pro plugin-claim license token (begins with 'AXON-'). When set, the plugin forwards this token on every governed request via the X-License-Token header so the agent applies Pro-tier entitlements (extended audit retention, higher quotas, license-gated capabilities). Wins over pluginConfig.licenseToken when both are set. Get one from getaxonflow.com/plugins/pro — the token is emailed to the address used at Stripe Checkout.

AXONFLOW_ENDPOINT.description: Override the AxonFlow agent gateway endpoint. Wins over pluginConfig.endpoint when both are set. When unset and AXONFLOW_COMMUNITY_SAAS is not opted out, the plugin auto-bootstraps against https://try.getaxonflow.com. For self-hosted deployments, set this (or pluginConfig.endpoint) to your AxonFlow URL.

AXONFLOW_RECOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Per-HTTP-request timeout in milliseconds for the axonflow-openclaw-recover CLI's calls to /api/v1/recover and /api/v1/recover/verify. Default: 10000 (10s). Increase for high-latency networks; decrease for fail-fast CI environments.

AXONFLOW_UPGRADE_URL.description: Override the upgrade URL surfaced by axonflow-openclaw-status to free-tier users when reporting Pro-tier features. Defaults to https://getaxonflow.com/pricing/.

AXONFLOW_PROFILE.description: Free-form deployment profile (e.g. 'production', 'staging', 'dev') reported on the anonymous 7-day heartbeat as the v1 telemetry-schema 'profile' field. Reports 'unknown' when unset. No behavioural effect; analytics dimension only.

AXONFLOW_TRY.description: Set to '1' to force the v1 telemetry deployment-mode classifier to report 'community_saas' even when the configured endpoint is a custom hostname. Use only when proxying try.getaxonflow.com behind a different host. No behavioural effect outside the heartbeat payload.

autoBootstrap.description: When pluginConfig.endpoint is unset and AXONFLOW_COMMUNITY_SAAS is not opted out, the plugin POSTs to https://try.getaxonflow.com/api/v1/register on first load to obtain Community-SaaS credentials, persists them at $AXONFLOW_CONFIG_DIR/try-registration.json (mode 0o600), and uses them for subsequent governance calls. The 7-day rotation refresh window keeps tenants from lapsing silently.
autoBootstrap.optOut: Set AXONFLOW_COMMUNITY_SAAS=0 OR set pluginConfig.endpoint to a self-hosted AxonFlow instance.
autoBootstrap.userDisclosure: First-load disclosure banner emitted via plugin logger (warn level), one time per machine, before the registration POST fires.

outboundData.atGovernanceTime: Tool name + arguments (before execution) and outbound message bodies (before delivery) are sent to the configured AxonFlow endpoint for policy evaluation and audit. With Community SaaS, the endpoint is try.getaxonflow.com; with self-hosted, traffic stays on your network.
outboundData.telemetry: Anonymous 7-day heartbeat to checkpoint.getaxonflow.com containing plugin version, OS, arch, runtime version, deployment mode, hook count, and a per-machine instance_id (UUID v4). No tool inputs, no message bodies, no LLM provider keys.
neverTransmitted: OpenClaw conversation history outside governed tools

files.purpose: Community-SaaS registration credentials (tenant_id, secret, expires_at). Refused at load time if permissions are not 0o600 on POSIX.
First-load disclosure stamp. Empty file; presence prevents re-warning on subsequent loads.
Heartbeat stamp file. Body is the per-machine instance_id (UUID v4); mtime drives the 7-day rate limit.
Rate-limit backoff stamp written when /api/v1/register returns 429. Body is a Unix timestamp (seconds) until which the bootstrap will not retry.

endpoint.label: AxonFlow Endpoint
endpoint.help: URL of your AxonFlow agent gateway

userEmail.label: User Email
userEmail.help: Per-user identity forwarded as the X-User-Email header. Required for the override lifecycle endpoints (createOverride, revokeOverride, listOverrides) and for correct per-user scoping on explainDecision. Block-path features still work without it.

licenseToken.label: Pro License Token
licenseToken.help: AxonFlow Pro plugin-claim license token. When set, the plugin forwards this on every governed request via X-License-Token so the agent applies Pro-tier entitlements (longer audit retention, higher quotas, license-gated capabilities). AXONFLOW_LICENSE_TOKEN env var wins over this value.

highRiskTools.label: High-Risk Tools
highRiskTools.help: Comma-separated tool names requiring human approval even when policy allows

governedTools.label: Governed Tools
governedTools.help: Only govern these tools. Empty means all tools are governed.

excludedTools.label: Excluded Tools
excludedTools.help: Exclude these tools from governance. Takes precedence over governedTools.

defaultOperation.label: Default Operation
defaultOperation.help: Operation type for mcp_check_input: 'execute' (default) or 'query' for read-only tools

requestTimeoutMs.label: Request Timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.help: Timeout for AxonFlow policy checks, output scans, audit writes, and health checks. Increase for remote deployments.
